notes.title: DICED Pilot is available now!!!
notes.content: DICED Pilot is now available with a launch discount of 25% off just in time for the Steam Winter Sale! Be sure to check out the demo if you haven't.

notes.title: DICED Pilot Demo Available Now
notes.content:
Attention gamers!

We are excited to announce that the demo for DICED Pilot is now available for you to try. This 2D action game combines old-school platform-based movement and jump timing challenges with physics-based surroundings, jetpacks, and weapons that can destroy everything in sight.

In the demo, players will have access to 17 levels to try out some of the various abilities the full game has to offer.

DICED Pilot is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat with its fast-paced gameplay and diverse level design. So don't wait, try the demo now and see for yourself why DICED Pilot is a must-play for any action game fan.
